rationale: With Justice Thomas assigning and having the strongest, most developed remedial-and-textual theory (no clear EMTALA abortion mandate; limits on supremacy equity), he is most likely to write a majority reversing on both merits and remedy. Separate writings are likely because the minority coalesces around a narrow as-applied preemption theory, while multiple majority justices may add concurrences emphasizing §1395dd(f) “direct conflict,” transfer/lawful-treatment alternatives, and Armstrong/Whole Woman’s Health constraints.
